lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Good morning, thanks for calling, this is Sam. How can I help?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Hello, I ordered a desk lamp last week and I would like to know where my order is right now.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Of course, I can check that for you. What is the order number?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: The order number is eight eight one three.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thanks. Your package left our warehouse yesterday and it is with the courier now. It should arrive on Thursday.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Perfect, that is good to know. Can I get the tracking link?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Sure, I have just sent the tracking link to your email address.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Great, thank you very much for your help.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: You are welcome, enjoy your new lamp.
